subject: Can we fold the demo into GreenBridge stopover on Oct 6?
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@greenbridgehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Demo window on Oct 6 — travel hiccup

Hi Ben,

Quick heads-up: our schedule for Oct 6 just changed — the leadership team is being shuttled between the downtown clinic and a field screening event. We'll have a hard stop and a 35–40 minute window while the team transitions (likely around 14:00 local).

Is there any way we can condense the demo into a focused 25–30 minute run-through during that stopover, or alternatively fold the demo into the field tour itself? The goal is to see the core inference flows (chat + embeddings) and a quick ops/SLAs overview.

I've attached the field-tour agenda so you can see the timing. Aaron Kim (cc) will be on the ground that day. If a short live demo won't work, we're also open to a recorded walkthrough followed by a 15-min live Q&A.

Thanks — sorry for the late shuffle.

Samantha Lee
Director of IT Programs | GreenBridge Health
Samantha.Lee@greenbridgehealth.com
Attachment: greenbridge-field-tour-agenda.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@greenbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo window on Oct 6 — travel hiccup

Hi Samantha — appreciate the heads-up. Short answer: yes. We can adapt. Options that usually work for this kind of transit window: 

- 25–30 minute condensed demo at the stopover (focus: read-only embeddings search + live chat integration + 1-slide ops/latency/cost). Jonas would run the live model bits remotely.
- Merge into the field tour: we can do a very short 10–15 minute in-person highlight (screens up) and then share a recording for the deeper flows.
- Record the 40–45 minute walkthrough ahead of time and hold a 15-minute live Q&A during the stopover.

If you want the condensed live demo, proposed slot: Oct 6, 14:00–14:30 local. I can send a calendar invite; Jonas will dial in from the East Coast to handle the technical deep-dive, and Evelyn will join to discuss onboarding/phased rollout and next steps.

I've attached a 1-page short-demo brief that maps features to a 30-minute agenda. If you're good with the slot, I'll lock it and include a quick setup checklist for the onsite AV (we typically need a stable Wi‑Fi and an HDMI if you prefer local screen share).

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Attachment: short-demo-brief.pdf
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@greenbridgehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Kim <aaron.kim@greenbridgehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo window on Oct 6 — travel hiccup

Hi Ben — thanks, that all sounds reasonable.

We'd prefer the condensed live demo at 14:00–14:30 on Oct 6. Aaron confirmed he can carve out the stopover window and will help with the room/AV. Please assume a mixed audience: 2 IT leads (incl. Aaron), 1 product lead, and 2 operations managers — they want to see the chat flow and embeddings search example most.

Can you (a) include a short list of prereq items we should have on site, and (b) record the session for the product lead who'll be on the bus?

Attaching a quick note with the day's logistics/meeting point (link to shared folder).

Best,
Samantha

1) Stable internet (cell hotspot is OK, prefer Wi‑Fi at >= 10 Mbps down)
2) Laptop with HDMI (or adapter) to mirror our slides if needed

Jonas will join remote to run the live model queries and will record the session; Evelyn will join for the rollout/pricing Q&A at the end.
